Which ticker had the best return?: SELECT ticker FROM market.gold.gold_ticker_summary WHERE period_return = (SELECT MAX(period_return) FROM market.gold.gold_ticker_summary)
What was the worst drawdown for AAPL?: SELECT MIN(drawdown) FROM market.gold.gold_price_metrics WHERE ticker = 'AAPL'
How many trading days does each ticker h: SELECT ticker, COUNT(*) FROM market.gold.gold_price_metrics GROUP BY ticker
